scope.geometry: Signed distance to the untrimmed regular ring-torus locus
scope.domain: Finite decoded torus face with majorRadius > minorRadius > 0 and a finite nonzero axis
scope.distance_policy: Hypot of axial distance and radial distance from the major circle, minus minor radius; negative inside the tube and positive outside the tube
scope.tolerance_policy: Explicit finite nonnegative caller tolerance; no ACIS/modeler default is assumed
scope.numeric_policy: Direct finite-coordinate calculation preserves ordinary boundary precision; scaled fallback handles point-center differences or derived radial/axial coordinates that overflow doubles
scope.model_validity_policy: Utility validates only its supported analytic input domain and does not establish ACIS surface, face, shell, solid, or B-rep validity
non_claims: native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification
